capabilities: toggle a third checkbox state with shift-click
toggle the third state by long press on mobile
customize base and hover colors of the third-state checkbox
problem: Obsidian task checkboxes only have two states (done or not done), with no way to mark a task as partially complete.
summary: Adds a third, partially-complete state to task list checkboxes, toggled by shift-click on desktop or long press on mobile.
